# Product associated to a deleted tags are present in the search result in FO

Tags are deleted from the BO but still exist  with associated product in the FO.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/89604350/164035978-28e6bfbd-32e5-49e9-9850-1c84bfc8e626.mp4

## Attendu
Product associated to a deleted tags are not present in the search result in FO

## Étapes
1. Add a tag from Product V2 page
2. Go to BO > Shop parameters > Search > Tags page
3. Delete the created tag
4. Go to FO and search with this tag
5. See error > The product still displayed in the search result
